note: بـ start, ـا end. ا never joins forward, so the last ب stands alone: ب.
كـ start, ـتـ middle, ـا end; after the gap, ب alone.
و alone (it never joins forward), then لـ start, ـد end.
قـ start, ـلـ middle, ـم end: one unbroken word.
جـ start, ـد end; after the gap, يـ start, ـد end. Kasra + ي is the long ī.
كـ start, ـبـ middle, ـيـ middle, ـر end.
صـ start, ـغـ middle, ـيـ middle, ـر end. In the middle, غ is a small closed loop with a dot.
طـ start, ـا end; after the gap, لـ start, ـب end.
شـ start, ـا end; after the gap, ر alone; ر never joins forward, so ع stands alone too.
سـ start, ـو end; after the gap, ق alone. Damma + و is the long ū.
نـ start, ـو end; after the gap, ر alone.
مـ start, ـد end; after the gap, يـ start, ـنـ middle, ـة end.
سـ start, ـمـ middle, ـك end.
حـ start, ـلـ middle, ـيـ middle, ـب end.
صـ start, ـد end; after the gap, يـ start, ـق end.
سـ start, then ل and ا melt into one shape, ـلا; after the gap, م alone.
ثـ start, ـلا (lām alif); after the gap, ثـ start, ـة end.
مـ start, ـطـ middle, ـا end; after the gap, ر alone.
Moon letter ب: the l is said, with sukun. al-bāb, like al-qamar.
Sun letter د: the l is silent and د is doubled (shadda). ad-dars, like ash-shams.
Moon letter و: the l is said. al-walad, like al-qamar.
Sun letter ن: the l is silent and ن is doubled. an-nūr, like ash-shams.
Moon letter م: the l is said. al-madīna, like al-qamar.
Sun letter ر: the l is silent and ر is doubled. ar-rajul, like ash-shams.
Moon letter ي: the l is said. al-yawm, like al-qamar.
Sun letter ص: the l is silent and ص is doubled. aṣ-ṣabāḥ, like ash-shams.
